Fields.Name: Layout Path
Fields.Description: Name of the menu element (in the panel's layout) that shows this entry, e.g. "TopItem_0". Empty: ends the panel's list of rows.

Fields.Name: Menu Property ID
Fields.Description: MenuPropertySpecParam row (property) whose value is shown in this element. The element is hidden when the property gives no text and Caption Text ID is 0 or less.

Fields.Name: Caption Text ID
Fields.Description: If a valid text ID is set, this will be displayed in preference to the property name.

Fields.Name: Help Text ID
Fields.Description: Only if this is a valid text ID will it be selectable in the field help.
